# splitmix64 reference vectors, spec §5.6 (normative).
# The stream below is the *raw* splitmix64 stream from state = the decimal seed
# in column 1, with no stream constant mixed in. Four draws per line.
#
# The generator itself never uses this raw stream: it seeds two purpose-separated
# streams (seed ^ C_fill, seed ^ C_sequence, §5.7). These vectors exist so a port
# proves its splitmix64 before it plays a game.
#
